name: Як це називається? Захист від мату
description:
You already know how you can defend against mate: by moving, protecting, capturing or blocking.
In this lesson you have to prevent Black from checkmating your king. We don't say how to do that. You have to figure it out yourself.
 

After you have made your move, you will see a question. Check the name of the technique you have used. 


What do you have to do?

Defend against checkmate
